title: Robust inflammatory breast cancer gene signature using nonparametric random forest analysis
summary: Random-forest analysis of expression datasets derived the 59-gene G59 signature for inflammatory breast cancer. It distinguished untreated inflammatory-breast-cancer samples in independent datasets, but did not classify primarily post-treatment samples reliably; the signature remains a candidate molecular classifier.
ai_technology: Nonparametric random forest feature analysis and G59 gene-signature classification

evidence.tested: G59 classified 45/45 discovery/validation samples and 60/61 samples in an independent pretreatment dataset; TCGA testing yielded 1.6% IBC-like classifications.
evidence.unknown: Performance did not transfer reliably to primarily post-treatment samples; this is retrospective expression-data validation, not prospective diagnostic use.
evidence.ai_role: Random forest analysis prioritized genes and derived the 59-gene signature distinguishing inflammatory breast cancer from comparison samples.

source_review.scope: Publisher full-text Methods and Results; date and exact-result catalog comparison checked.
